decisions.reason: The candidate already has a message-56 MODIFY capturing the Sign In page's informational purpose, required background and header logo, landing-page background basis, and optional footer.

The existing message-56 MODIFY records the informational-page exception but leaves the prior unconditional shared-header-and-footer rule stale; the footer is now optional for the Sign In and Account Provisioning pages.

decisions.reason: Simplifying the Account Provisioning wizard's page styling does not alter the independently requested design-system handoff artifacts.
The legal-document links are established by a separate footer clause in the same message and remain valid regardless of the provisioning wizard's simplified styling.
The Account Provisioning wizard is an informational page whose styling is separate from the console shell container requirement.
Using the landing-page background as a basis for authentication-page styling does not change the landing page's own visual-system requirements.
The provisioning wizard styling decision does not change the landing-page How It Works section's position, presentation, or content.
The informational-page styling decision does not alter whether previously supplied follow-on copy belongs on the landing page.
The source does not change the landing page's sign-up call to action.
The source specifies visual elements for two informational pages but does not modify cross-page responsive behavior or breakpoint guidance.
The source does not change the landing page's responsive-layout behavior.
